_meta.description: Annual wage inflation multipliers per occupation family. Applied compoundly to ISPV 2025 data (published March 2026) as factor^(age_months/12).
_meta.methodology: Per-family annual wage growth derived from ČSÚ quarterly CZ-NACE sectoral data (2025) cross-referenced with Hays CZ salary guide and sector-specific sources. IT inflated more aggressively due to AI/cloud premium confirmed across Q1-Q4 2025 (CZ-NACE J+M averaged ~11-12% YoY). Healthcare sourced from ČSÚ Q2 data and Expats.cz reporting a confirmed +10% government-backed increase. Education sourced from government-mandated +7% tariff increase for teachers effective January 2025 (Radio Prague International). Trades based on ČSÚ construction sector: Q2 +11%, Q3 +9.5% — using conservative mid of subset. Services based on ČSÚ 'other activities' and accommodation/food: 3.4-5% range — conservative floor. Legal has no dedicated ČSÚ series; estimated from SalaryExpert +18%/5yr projection (~3.4% p.a.) blended with professional-services umbrella (~7% average) → conservative 1.05. Conservative baseline for unknown families: ČNB headline nominal wage inflation 2025 = 7.2%, deflated for MVP conservatism to 1.04.

confidence_per_family.it: high (ČSÚ CZ-NACE J+M Q1-Q4 2025 consistent 10-12% YoY; Hays CZ guide confirms IT as top performer; Recruiter's Diary CZ IT data corroborates)
confidence_per_family.healthcare: medium-high (ČSÚ Q2 2025 sectoral data + Expats.cz confirmed +10% median jump; government-backed increases give structural support)
confidence_per_family.legal: low-medium (no dedicated ČSÚ series for legal; estimated from professional-services umbrella + SalaryExpert growth projection; high variance between Big Law and SME firms)
confidence_per_family.education: high (government-mandated +7% tariff increase for teachers effective 2025-01-01 confirmed by Radio Prague International; state tariff tables are authoritative)
confidence_per_family.trades: medium (ČSÚ construction Q2-Q3 2025: +9.5-11%; broader trades including electrical/metalwork have similar but slightly lower growth; conservative mid applied)
confidence_per_family.services: low (ČSÚ 'other activities' 3.4-5% represents low end; accommodation and food services not separately broken out; high variance within category)
confidence_per_family.other: low (fallback to conservative fraction of ČNB headline nominal wage inflation 2025 = 7.2%)
